title: 第21章 拜访丞相府第22章 拜访丞相府2
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 萧风刚刚回到汉王府，抬眼便瞧见曹正淳早已在门外等候，一见到萧风回来，曹正淳急忙迎上前去，说道：“刚刚袁天罡传来丞相府的消息，这丞相呼延墨岩，修炼天赋实在是平平无奇，如今是玄阶修为，全是依仗陛下耗费大量精力寻来珍贵的丹药，才得以到现在的水平。至于......”萧风直接打断还要继续的曹正淳，说道：“去书房，不要在这里说了。”
曹正淳这时也发现，确实是不合适，于是跟着萧风进了书房。
萧风换了衣服，直接说道：“袁天罡为何会只送来丞相府的消息？”
曹正淳躬身道：“贾诩先生让袁天罡送过来的，他说殿下应该去拜访一下丞相府了，还有就是见一见未来的王妃。”说罢便看向了站在旁边的贾诩。
贾诩只是微微的笑了笑，没有说话。
萧风示意曹正淳继续刚刚的话题，曹正淳又继续说道：“至于未来的王妃呼延欢颜，修炼天赋在同一辈中也是可以的，有很多宗门都想收她为内门弟子，但是丞相一直没有同意，而且王妃也不喜欢和宗门的人打交道，除了修炼之外，还听闻王妃喜欢弹琴。至于呼延熊焱天赋和修为都一般，现在在边关，而丞相夫人早几年就去世了，丞相大人也没有续弦。”
萧风听完这些内容后也在思索，于是出声道：“你先安排人去给丞相府送拜帖，说我晚上过去。”
曹正淳回道：“贾诩先生已经安排过了，至于礼物，奴才已经和华神医拿了一些能够助人突破修为的丹药，而且特意选了副作用相对较小的。只是这古琴，王府之中没有，奴才也让人去外面打听了，暂时还没有消息。”
萧风点了点头，说：“古琴，我这里有，你先拿去，再准备些其他的礼物，第一次上门，不要显得太寒酸了，你先去准备吧。”萧风说完便把上次签到获得的青瑶古琴从系统仓库中拿出来，同时还拿出来了些小玩意，都递给了曹正淳，反正也是签到获得的，没什么大用，就都给了曹正淳，反正曹正淳会安排好的。
曹正淳拿完东西之后，便退出了书房，书房只剩下了萧风和贾诩。
萧风看着贾诩说道：“文和，你觉得，我今晚怎么和呼延墨岩说？”
贾诩直言道：“殿下，直接说就可以了，还有就是直接表明自己要夺嫡，让丞相给您直接指路即可。”
“直接说会不会不太好？毕竟我还没有娶到呼延欢颜，直接表明心意，这传到父皇那里，我怎么处理？”萧风也是很疑惑的看着贾诩。
只见贾诩摇了摇头，微笑的说道：“殿下，陛下赐婚给你，就是要把丞相大人绑在你的阵营中，陛下怎么可能不知道你要夺嫡呢？你开府的时候不是已经和陛下说过了？如果殿下你不夺嫡的话，陛下就不会让您娶呼延欢颜了，毕竟想娶呼延欢颜的人很多，又不缺您一个。”
萧风也是听完之后，觉得贾诩说的很对，于是说：“你晚上和我一起去丞相府吧，这样有个照应。”
贾诩这时却是摇了摇头，说道：“殿下，这件事需要你自己处理，许褚和曹正淳陪你去，您也可以带上萧雅，路上我会安排护龙山庄和不良人保护您。”
萧风也是点了点头，问到：“萧雅最近怎么样？好几天都没见她了？”
贾诩说道：“她很好，还没有让她开始修炼，只是在打基础，殿下也要尽快召唤出个儒士了。”
萧风也是想召唤，但是现在的次数太少了，而且他还要留着以防万一，也只是点了点头。
时间悄然流逝，转眼时间便来到了傍晚时分，萧风从汉王府走出来，登上了自己的马车，车内，他与妹妹萧雅相对而坐，听着萧雅这几天发生的事情，萧风也是一脸宠爱的看着萧雅。
而车内，曹正淳也在旁边静静的坐着，目光温和地注视着萧风和萧雅，此时好像是难得的温馨时刻。
没多久，马车缓缓停在了丞相府门前。只见丞相带着一众人早已等候在此，除去呼延欢颜，整个丞相府在呼延墨岩的带领下，都在等候着萧风的到来。
萧风下了马车，赶忙迎上去，对着呼延墨岩说道：“丞相大人，您没必要这么兴师动众的，真是折煞我了。”
呼延墨岩连忙开口道：“汉王殿下，这是第一次来到臣这里，应该是用这种规格的。”随后呼延墨岩领着萧风等人，走进了丞相府。
萧风走进丞相府才发现，丞相府的布置很简单，一点都看不出是一个位高权重的丞相的府邸。呼延墨岩也是看出了萧风的疑惑，说道：“臣，没什么家人，原本就是孤身一人，与妻子也是相识在与陛下相遇之前，之后，产下一儿一女，也没有纳妾，所以人丁单薄，就没有弄那么复杂，况且犬子也常年不在身边，只是剩欢颜在身边，就布置的简单了点。”
萧风也是知道这些信息，于是呼延墨岩把萧风引进了正厅，正厅之中有一女子，坐在那里，正是呼延欢颜。
呼延欢颜听着有人来，连忙起身，当他看清楚萧风的脸庞时，顿时愣住了惊呼“是你！”
萧风笑着回复道：“又见面了呼延小姐。”
呼延欢颜脸一红，便不再说话了，呼延墨岩也是愣了一下，问道：“殿下，你和欢颜之前见过？”
萧风点了点头，“我们在逍遥阁见过面，但是当时只是匆匆一瞥，没想到是丞相千金。”
呼延墨岩也是笑着说道：“没想到还有这样的缘分，好了咱们开始用膳吧。”
呼延欢颜也是扭扭捏捏的在一旁，萧风一直在和呼延墨岩谈着事情，呼延欢颜则是偷偷的在偷瞄着萧风，这时一只小手突然拉住呼延欢颜的手，说道：“你就是我未来嫂子吗？”
呼延欢颜才发现跟着萧风一起来的一个小丫头，过来拉着她的小手，虽然呼延欢颜不在朝堂，但是也是听闻了陛下新收的义女，碧落公主，于是也是一把抱起来，说道：“是啊，我就是你未来嫂子。”说完这句话，呼延欢颜也是偷摸的看了眼萧风，同时小脸也是变得通红。

content_en:
Xiao Feng had just returned to Prince Han's Mansion when he looked up and saw Cao Zhengchun already waiting outside the door. As soon as he saw Xiao Feng coming back, Cao Zhengchun hurriedly stepped forward to greet him and said: "Just now, news came from Yuan Tiangang from the Prime Minister's Mansion. This Prime Minister Huyan Moyan's cultivation talent is really mediocre. It's strange that you are now at Xuan level, and you have reached your current level only because your Majesty spent a lot of energy to find precious pills. As for..." Xiao Feng directly interrupted Cao Zhengchun who was about to continue, and said: "Go to the study, don't talk here."
Cao Zhengchun also realized at this time that it was indeed inappropriate, so he followed Xiao Feng into the study.
Xiao Feng changed his clothes and said directly: "Why did Yuan Tiangang only send news from the Prime Minister's Mansion?"
Cao Zhengchun bowed and said: "Mr. Jia Xu asked Yuan Tiangang to send it here. He said that His Highness should visit the Prime Minister's Mansion and meet the future princess." After that, he looked at Jia Xu who was standing next to him.
Jia Xu just smiled slightly and said nothing.
Xiao Feng signaled Cao Zhengchun to continue the topic, and Cao Zhengchun continued: "As for the future princess Hu Yanhuanyan, her cultivation talent is acceptable among the same generation. Many sects want to accept her as an inner disciple, but the prime minister has never agreed. Moreover, the princess does not like to interact with people from the sect. In addition to practicing, she also heard that the princess likes to play the piano. As for Huyan Xiongyan, whose talent and cultivation are average, he is currently in the border area, and the prime minister’s wife passed away a few years ago, and the prime minister has not continued. "
Xiao Feng was also thinking after hearing these contents, so he said: "First arrange for someone to send a greeting card to the Prime Minister's Mansion, and tell me that I will come over in the evening."
Cao Zhengchun replied: "Mr. Jia Xu has already arranged it. As for the gift, I have already taken some elixirs with Divine Doctor Hua that can help people break through the cultivation level, and specially selected the ones with relatively small side effects. However, this guqin is not available in the palace, and I have asked people to go outside to inquire about it. There is no news yet."
Xiao Feng nodded and said: "Guqin, I have it here. You take it first and prepare some other gifts. Don't look too shabby when you come to the house for the first time. You go and prepare it first." After Xiao Feng said that, he took the gifts he got from the last sign-in. Qingyao Guqin took out some gadgets from the system warehouse and handed them all to Cao Zhengchun. They were obtained by signing in anyway. They were of no great use, so they were given to Cao Zhengchun. Cao Zhengchun would arrange them anyway.
After Cao Zhengchun took the things, he exited the study. Only Xiao Feng and Jia Xu were left in the study.
Xiao Feng looked at Jia Xu and said, "Wenhe, what do you think I should tell Huyan Moyan tonight?"
Jia Xu said bluntly: "Your Highness, just say it directly. Alternatively, you can directly state that you want to seize the throne and let the Prime Minister give you direct guidance."
"Wouldn't it be good to tell her directly? After all, I haven't married Hu Yanhuan yet, so I have to express my feelings directly. How should I handle this when it reaches my father?" Xiao Feng also looked at Jia Xu in confusion.
Jia Xu shook his head and said with a smile: "Your Highness, His Majesty gave you the marriage just to tie the Prime Minister into your camp. How could His Majesty not know that you want to seize the legitimate son? Didn't you already tell His Majesty when you opened the palace? If Your Highness did not seize the legitimate son, Your Majesty would not let you marry Huyan Huanyan. After all, there are many people who want to marry Huyan Huanyan, and there is no shortage of you."
After hearing this, Xiao Feng felt that what Jia Xu said was right, so he said, "You can go to the Prime Minister's Mansion with me tonight, so that I can take care of you."
Jia Xu shook his head at this time and said: "Your Highness, you need to handle this matter by yourself. Xu Chu and Cao Zhengchun will accompany you. You can also take Xiao Ya with you. I will arrange Dragon Guard Villa and bad guys to protect you on the way."
Xiao Feng also nodded and asked: "How is Xiao Ya lately? Haven't seen her for several days?"
Jia Xu said: "She is very good. She has not started practicing yet. She is just laying the foundation. Your Highness will summon a Confucian scholar as soon as possible."
Xiao Feng also wanted to summon, but the number of times now was too few, and he wanted to keep it just in case, so he just nodded.
Time passed quietly, and in the blink of an eye it was evening. Xiao Feng walked out of Prince Han's Mansion and boarded his carriage. In the carriage, he and his sister Xiao Ya sat opposite each other. Listening to what happened to Xiao Ya in the past few days, Xiao Feng looked at Xiao Ya fondly.
In the car, Cao Zhengchun was sitting quietly next to them, looking at Xiao Feng and Xiao Ya with gentle eyes. This seemed to be a rare warm moment.
Not long after, the carriage slowly stopped in front of the Prime Minister's Mansion. The Prime Minister and a group of people were already waiting here. Except for Hu Yan Huanyan, the entire Prime Minister's Mansion, led by Hu Yan Moyan, was waiting for Xiao Feng's arrival.
Xiao Feng got off the carriage, hurriedly greeted him, and said to Huyan Moyan: "Prime Minister, there is no need for you to mobilize troops like this. You are really embarrassing me."
Huyan Moyan quickly said: "His Royal Highness, this is your first time here. It should be of this standard." Then Huyan Moyan led Xiao Feng and others into the Prime Minister's Mansion.
Xiao Feng walked into the Prime Minister's Mansion and found that the layout of the Prime Minister's Mansion was very simple, and it did not look like the residence of a high-ranking prime minister at all. Huyan Moyan also saw Xiao Feng's doubts and said: "My lord, I don't have any family. I was alone originally. I met my wife before I met His Majesty. After that, I gave birth to a son and a daughter, and I didn't take any concubines. So the population is small, so it's not that complicated. Besides, the dog is not around all the year round. He only has Huanyan by his side, so the arrangement is a bit simpler."
Xiao Feng also knew this information, so Huyan Moyan introduced Xiao Feng into the main hall. There was a woman sitting there, it was Huyan Huanyan.
When Huyan Huanyan heard someone coming, he stood up quickly. When he saw Xiao Feng's face clearly, he was stunned and exclaimed, "It's you!"
Xiao Feng smiled and replied: "I met Miss Huyan again."
Huyan Huanyan blushed and stopped talking. Huyan Moyan was also stunned for a moment and asked: "Your Highness, have you and Huanyan met before?"
Xiao Feng nodded, "We met in Xiaoyao Pavilion, but we only had a quick glance at him. I didn't expect that he was the prime minister's daughter."
Huyan Moyan also smiled and said: "I didn't expect such a fate. Okay, let's start eating."
Huyan Huanyan was also coquettishly standing aside. Xiao Feng had been talking to Huyan Moyan, and Huyan Huanyan was secretly peeking at Xiao Feng. At this time, a small hand suddenly took Huyan Huanyan's hand and said, "Are you my future sister-in-law?"
Huyan Huanyan discovered a little girl who came with Xiao Feng and came over to hold her little hand. Although Huyanhuanyan was not in the court, she also heard about His Majesty's newly adopted daughter-in-law, Princess Biluo, so she hugged her and said, "Yes, I am your future sister-in-law." After saying this, Huyanhuanyan glanced at Xiao Feng secretly, and her face turned red at the same time.
